note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a Const 123(1), 126, Sections 16-17, Third Schedule; A06b Const 123(1), 126, Sections 16-17, Third Schedule; L05 Const 134(1)(a)): ordinary naturalisation after 10 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Singapore, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Singapore for 12 months immediately prior to the application, and was resident in the country for 10 out of 12 years prior to the application. ... Renunciation of citizenship of another country required. ... Person acquired citizenship of another country by a voluntary and formal act other than by marriage.
